description: This course, offered by the Department of Humanities & Social Sciences, aims to develop communication skills among engineering students: to build confidence in speaking English with correct pronunciation, to develop basic writing skills and vocabulary, and to develop the ability to comprehend text in various contexts. It is taught in two parts — Theory Teaching and Language Laboratory.

syllabus.title: Introduction to Communication Skills
syllabus.body: Meaning and definition of communication, forms of communication, barriers to effective communication, ways to overcome barriers in communication; Communication Skills: Listening Skills, Speaking Skills, Reading Skills, Writing Skills; Technical Communication; Digital Communication.

syllabus.title: Soft Skills for Professional Excellence
syllabus.body: Introduction to soft skills: meaning, nature, scope and importance of soft skills in the present organizational set up; managing interpersonal relationships: leadership skills, team work, attitude, creativity, resilience etc.; nonverbal communication: body language and gestures, significance and role of body language in effective communication across cultures.

syllabus.title: Written Communication
syllabus.body: Formal letters, curriculum vitae and resume writing, writing e-mails, technical reports with an emphasis on different styles and structures/formats.

syllabus.title: Grammar and Punctuation
syllabus.body: Parts of speech, tenses, subject verb, active passive, interjections, capitalization etc. Use of comma, period, exclamation marks, ellipsis, question mark, colon, semi-colon, quotation marks, apostrophe etc. Common errors and acceptable forms of English language.

languageLab.title: Listening Skills
languageLab.body: Listening Process and practice - introduction to recorded lectures, poems, interviews and speeches, listening tests, problems in comprehension and retention, importance of listening in organizational set up.

languageLab.title: Reading and Pronunciation Skills
languageLab.body: Phonetics and Phonology: Introduction to sounds, vowel and consonant sounds, diphthongs etc. IPA transcription of words, word stress, weak forms, voice, intonation, tone etc.

languageLab.title: Soft Skills
languageLab.body: Proper use of Body Language: facial expressions, eye contact, gestures, postures and dressing; emotions displayed by body language; different types of handshakes; desirable and undesirable body language under different professional situations.

languageLab.title: Speaking Skills
languageLab.body: Standard and formal speech: Activities like Group discussion, oral presentations, public speaking, business presentations etc. Conversation practice and role playing, mock interviews etc.

outcomes: Communicate effectively with an increase in their confidence to read, write and speak English fluently.
Demonstrate a significant increase in word power.
Participate in a conversation like listening carefully and respectfully to others' viewpoints; articulating their own ideas and questions clearly.
Prepare, organize, and deliver an engaging oral presentation.
